svg.title: Schematic plan of Kai no Hama, the shell garden at Awaji Yumebutai: six long shallow pools separated by narrow concrete strips, each pool spilling over its lower edge into the next, with a terrace and steps along one side and a row of tall thin trees along the other.

g.text: Shell bed drawn in one pool only — all six are floored the same way.
SCHEMATIC — the number of pools, their widths and their falls are indicative, not measured.
